issues.on_page: Debt Service Taxes 426,414 (p5); Statement of Activities Property taxes 1,847,245 (p3)
issues.issue: Subtraction reconciles exactly: SOA Property taxes 1,847,245 - General Fund property 1,103,299 - motor vehicle 128,384 - occupation 189,148 (p13) = 426,414, so the statements arguably establish the Debt Service fund taxes as property tax. Extractor left it unlabeled because the SOA 'Property taxes' line also holds the General Fund motor vehicle and occupation taxes. Judgment call.
